notes: All source PNGs were read without modification; original archive is not altered.
All sheets use 160x128 RGBA and a 5x4 grid of 32x32 cells.
Each sheet has occupied cells 0-15 and empty cells 16-19.
All source alpha values are binary (0 or 255), so GIF transparency can be preserved without alpha flattening.
Frame order is row-major across the 16 occupied cells. This produces the visible scale/pulse progression in the sheets.
